d: An entire colony of up to 5,000 rare narrow-headed ants has been stolen from a nature reserve in Devon, England. The reserve is the last known stronghold of the species in the country. But this is not an isolated incident. Kenya has also witnessed multiple cases of suspected ant smuggling, with thousands of live ants seized by authorities. As ant-keeping grows into a global hobby, demand for rare and exotic species is creating a market for illegal wildlife trade. Why are collectors buying ants, and what does their removal mean for the ecosystem?
